commit.message: fix(ci): detect behind-main from the compare API, not mergeable_state

intent: Fix the reason the auto-rebase sweep reported success while doing nothing. The sweep selected PRs with jq 'select(.mergeable_state == "behind")', but mergeable_state is a single value with a precedence order in which "blocked" (a required check missing or failing) outranks "behind". On this repo nearly every behind-main PR is simultaneously blocked or unstable, so it reported "blocked" and the sweep skipped it silently — the operator still hand-pressed Update branch on every PR. Measure behind-ness directly with the compare API's behind_by count, categorise behind_main from that (mergeable_state stays a fallback), and select on the category while excluding conflicted branches a rebase cannot fix.

negative_controls.command: python3 -c "import subprocess,sys; from pathlib import Path; p=Path('scripts/governance/pr_ci_health.py'); orig=p.read_text(); mut=orig.replace('if triage.behind_by > 0 or state == \"behind\":', 'if state == \"behind\":'); assert mut!=orig; p.write_text(mut); r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','pytest','tests/test_pr_ci_health.py','-q'],check=False); p.write_text(orig); sys.exit(0 if r.returncode!=0 else 2)"
negative_controls.name: reverting-to-state-only-detection-breaks-contract-test

honest_blockers: This adds one compare-API call per open PR to the triage pass (about 30 today, alongside the two calls per PR it already makes). If open-PR count grows past a few hundred the triage step will need per-PR concurrency or a cheaper behind-ness source.

pr_ci_safe_rebase.py:331-342 still hard-skips any PR that changes a Session Entry packet or a .github/workflows file. Those PRs are now correctly SELECTED as behind_main and then declined by the helper, so the stranding stays visible in the log instead of being invisible at selection time — but it is not fixed. The structural fix remains a merge queue or clearing require-branches-up-to-date, both operator settings changes.
This PR is itself such an excluded PR (workflow + packet), so it will need one manual branch update if main moves before it merges.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the single commit; triage returns to state-keyed behind-main detection and the sweep to its previous jq filter. No state is touched — pr_ci_health.py is read-only.
